visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark brown hair wearing a blue t-shirt sits on a bed with a white comforter, speaking directly to the camera. Next to him is a toddler girl with a black bob haircut. Behind them is a plain white wall and a clear plastic water bottle. (2) The man begins to sing, gesturing with his hands. The toddler girl looks at him with a serious expression and eventually pulls the white duvet over her head to hide. The man continues to sing, pulling the blanket back as she tries to cover her ears. (3) The toddler emerges from the blanket and starts to cry, her face red and eyes squinted. The man smiles and laughs warmly, leaning in to hug and comfort her while continuing to speak to the camera. (4) The visual transitions to several years later. The man, now with slightly longer hair, sits with the girl who is now a teenager. They are in a different indoor setting with a bunk bed visible in the background. The man holds an acoustic guitar and plays while the girl looks at a tablet. (5) As the man sings, the teenage girl attempts to look disinterested by staring at her screen. However, her facial expression shifts from a stoic look to one of emotional distress. She eventually covers her face with her hands and the tablet, wiping away tears as the man smiles at her. (6) The man continues to sing and play the guitar while the girl reacts with a mix of embarrassment and genuine emotion, eventually hiding her face in her arms as they both laugh and cry together.
